To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we can detect Web spam more accurately using a classifier that combines link based features and language model based ones, and that we can achieve a good detection rate using fewer features, in particular, by using a small number of links from each Web page.

we have proposed a spam detection system based not only on the analysis of the content of Web pages but also on a qualitative analysis of the page links, and that the combination of both approaches provides a significant improvement of the spam detection results.
the proposed features improve the detection of Web pages that contain spam, and that the proposed classifier improves the detection of spam pages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) How can a search engine determine the actual page pointed at by a link?

the following questions: (i) how to detect Web spam pages, (ii) what are the features to use in the detection process, (iii) how to combine these features to obtain a good classifier, (iv) which is the best classifier, and (v) which is the impact of these new features in the detection of Web pages.

two aspects: the first is related to the development of a new classification model for Web spam detection based on a set of new features, which are not related to quantitative data from a Web page, but also to the qualitative properties of the links, and the second is related to the improvement of the detection of Web pages that have been artificially created for the sole purpose of increasing the ranking of a Web page in the results returned by a search engine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our system outperforms state-of-the-art systems on the two datasets used, and that it is able to do this using fewer features.
our system outperforms all of the other systems in both datasets, using a small set of features, and with a very high detection rate.

the new link based features and the language model based ones are very promising and complementary to each other, and that the combination of both of them provides a very good performance in the Web spam detection task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of link based features with LM based ones is an efficient way of detecting Web spam.
we have been able to improve the state of the art in Web spam detection, using a smaller set of features.
we have shown that it is possible to detect Web spam with very few features and that the combination of link analysis and language models can be used to detect Web spam.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of new link-based features with LM based features provides a powerful and efficient way to detect Web spam.
, in order to improve Web spam detection, it is important to take into account the qualitative properties of the links.
the link based features are more effective in the classification of the spam pages than the LM based ones.
